transferable_principles: Research anchors need short spatial and organizational links to prototypes, startups, public institutions and markets.
Flexible shared interfaces and existing-building adaptation can matter more than iconic new construction.
Talent, developer communities and public knowledge require recurring programmes, not only rentable space.
A station-centred public realm can connect independent institutions without claiming one operator controls them.
Responsible AI adoption is strongest when evaluation, human fallback and public explanation are part of the innovation pathway.
Annual events create value only when they leave reusable records, prototypes, partnerships or next-cycle problem lists.

scenarios.problem: Step-free routes, temporary obstruction and verified entrance status are uncertain.
scenarios.agent_action: Compare only verified route options, show uncertainty and hand off to staffed assistance.
scenarios.evaluation: Escorted task completion, obstruction, wrong-turn, human takeover and complaint closure; no invented threshold before field baseline.
scenarios.operator_role: registered mobility-information operator with station/public-space manager and staffed fallback
scenarios.human_responsibility: Field staff remain responsible for safety advice and assistance.
scenarios.release_condition: Verified route and entrance survey, visible uncertainty, static equivalent and staffed fallback.
scenarios.public_verification: Users correct the route at verification and appeal points.
scenarios.failure: Unsafe or inaccessible routing, material harm or unavailable fallback.
scenarios.rollback: Withdraw real-time guidance and restore static routes plus human service.
scenarios.no_ai_fallback: Tactile/static route map and staffed assistance.

scenarios.problem: Station-area service information becomes stale, untraceable or unavailable without an app.
scenarios.agent_action: Answer bounded questions from an approved dated directory, display provenance and offer paper or human fallback.
scenarios.evaluation: Traceable-answer review, task completion, human intervention, correction latency and complaint closure; no invented threshold.
scenarios.operator_role: registered public-information operator with precinct manager, service desk and independent complaint handler
scenarios.human_responsibility: Human service staff approve scope and handle disputed or safety-critical questions.
scenarios.release_condition: Approved directory, bounded scope, visible source/date, no profiling and non-digital equivalent.
scenarios.public_verification: Users challenge answers at verification and appeal points.
scenarios.failure: Fabricated or harmful information, lost provenance, unavailable fallback or unresolved repeated complaints.
scenarios.rollback: Withdraw the service, publish cause and review data deletion and reapplication conditions.
scenarios.no_ai_fallback: Dated paper directory, fixed signage and staffed desk.

scenarios.name_zh: 开源低速公共服务 Agent
scenarios.problem: A low-speed service device may be technically functional but still unsafe, inaccessible, opaque or obstructive in mixed public space.
scenarios.agent_action: Perform a bounded non-critical carrying or wayfinding task on a surveyed route, stop on uncertainty and yield to people.
scenarios.evaluation: Controlled accessibility and safety evaluation at Zhongzhiyuan, reproducibility review at the central interface, then limited time-and-route public first use; proposed protocol only.
scenarios.operator_role: registered device/service operator with site manager, independent evaluator and on-site human supervisor
scenarios.human_responsibility: A visible supervisor controls start, stop, takeover and incident response.
scenarios.release_condition: Surveyed bounded route, published task and exclusions, tested stop/takeover, accessible bypass and incident channel.
scenarios.public_verification: Public observers report blockage, discomfort, exclusion or task failure at the Dazhongsi sequence.
scenarios.failure: Collision or near miss, inaccessible bypass, repeated obstruction, remote-stop failure or absent supervisor.
scenarios.rollback: Remove the device from public space and return to controlled calibration; retire the version if safety evidence cannot be restored.
scenarios.no_ai_fallback: Human staff, trolley or static wayfinding performs the same non-critical service.

scenarios.agent_action: Explain a public problem, source and reproducible prototype without grading or profiling learners.
scenarios.data_boundary: Public course, repository and exhibit material only; no student profiling.
scenarios.release_condition: Sources, version and teacher/developer contact are visible.
scenarios.failure_and_fallback: Unsupported explanation or inaccessible content triggers withdrawal to teacher-led and printed material.

scenarios.agent_action: Navigate to verified non-diagnostic services and human help; never diagnose, triage emergencies or infer health status.
scenarios.data_boundary: Approved public service directory; no health record.
scenarios.release_condition: Non-diagnostic scope and emergency/human handoff are prominent.
scenarios.failure_and_fallback: Any diagnostic or unsafe advice triggers immediate withdrawal to staffed and printed referral.

scenarios.agent_action: Translate a merchant-approved basic directory without ranking, payment access or customer profiling.
scenarios.data_boundary: Opt-in merchant directory and public notices only.
scenarios.release_condition: Merchant approval, timestamp, correction route and equal offline directory.
scenarios.failure_and_fallback: Material mistranslation or unapproved promotion triggers correction and paper directory fallback.

scenarios.agent_action: Explain only cited public heritage records and distinguish history from design interpretation.
scenarios.data_boundary: Official public heritage sources and cleared text; no invented artefact or generated portrait.
scenarios.release_condition: Every historical claim has visible source and correction channel.
scenarios.failure_and_fallback: Uncited or disputed history is removed and replaced by source-labelled static interpretation.

scenarios.name_zh: 公园维护与热舒适助手
scenarios.agent_action: Summarize publicly approved inspection and comfort observations for maintenance prioritisation; no automatic work order or surveillance.
scenarios.data_boundary: Future authorized environmental and maintenance observations; no personal tracking.
scenarios.release_condition: Sensor necessity, maintenance owner and non-personal data retention are approved.
scenarios.failure_and_fallback: Missing or suspect data returns decisions to routine manual inspection.

scenarios.name_zh: 非决策型公共法律与政务导航
scenarios.name_en: Non-decision Public Legal and Administrative Navigation
scenarios.agent_action: Point to current official procedures and staffed help without making legal judgments, eligibility decisions or case predictions.
scenarios.data_boundary: Official public procedures and dated notices only; no case file.
scenarios.release_condition: Non-advice boundary, source date and staffed referral are visible.
scenarios.failure_and_fallback: Wrong procedure, lost provenance or implied legal decision triggers withdrawal to official printed and staffed channels.

scenarios.urban_problem: 学生、研究者与原型团队难以判断一项公共用途原型需要核对哪些标准、知识产权、校准、测试与孵化服务接口，也难以识别目录是否过期。
scenarios.place: AI 原点开放知识与孵化接口；连接众智园受控校准入口与中关村潜在专业服务翼。
scenarios.need: 获得有日期、有来源、非约束性的转化路径清单，并明确缺失证据与人工咨询入口。
scenarios.agent_action: 从经人工核准、带日期的公开服务目录中检索并生成非约束性路径清单，显示来源、缺失材料与人工联系人；不得作资格、审批、融资、供应商排名或投资判断。
data_existing: 官方任务书与公开标准目录
公开发布的专业服务说明
原型团队主动提供的非敏感问题描述
data_potential: 经责任角色维护的当前服务目录
公开校准与孵化接口日历
data_operator_required: 经批准的人工咨询入口
scenarios.evaluation: 检查来源覆盖、陈旧链接识别、任务完成、越权建议与人工纠错；本方案不报告实测阈值。
scenarios.operator_role: role-based innovation-service desk and accountable content steward
scenarios.human_responsibility: 专业服务人员核对适用性并对咨询、受理和任何决定承担责任；Agent 只组织公开路径。
scenarios.release_condition: 目录经人工批准并带日期，非咨询/非审批边界清晰，不进行用户画像，且保留人工和纸本路径。
scenarios.public_verification: 团队可在 AI 原点开源贡献场报告失效链接、错误路径或遗漏服务，修正记录进入下一次目录更新。
scenarios.failure: 引用失效来源、暗示已获批准或融资、进行资格判断、供应商排名或无法转接人工。
scenarios.rollback: 停止生成个性化路径，公开更正并退回经人工核准的静态服务地图与咨询台。
scenarios.no_ai_fallback: 带日期的纸本服务地图、核对清单和人工咨询。
scenarios.calibration_relation: 把开放原型送入专业支持与校准受理，但不替代众智园测试、大钟寺发布门或任何正式决定。

scenarios.name_zh: AI 服务失效时的连续性
scenarios.agent_action: The AI layer stops; the city preserves the underlying service through human assistance and non-digital information.
scenarios.data_boundary: No personal or live AI data is required.
scenarios.release_condition: Every AI-enabled service must demonstrate this fallback before release.
scenarios.failure_and_fallback: Manual assistance, static and tactile signage, paper information, accessible non-digital route and complaint channel remain available.

operation_framework.status_note: Roles are functional placeholders. No real institution, contract, data authorization, roster or statutory response time is claimed.

data_governance.authorization: Record source, lawful or authorized basis and accountable data role before release; unconfirmed data cannot enter service.
data_governance.minimization: Use only fields necessary for the bounded public task; prohibit unrelated trajectories, profiles, health records, payments and case files.
data_governance.retention: Set a case-specific retention period before release and publish the category, purpose and review date.
data_governance.deletion: Define deletion or irreversible anonymization for raw, derived and incident data, including disposition after rollback or retirement.
data_governance.access: Role-based access and an auditable correction path are prerequisites, not existing capabilities.

human_operation.manual_takeover: Every operating shift requires an identifiable duty and takeover role with tested stop control.
human_operation.maintenance: The registered service operator is responsible for routine maintenance; the site-operations role is accountable for public-space availability and safe shutdown.

public_governance.public_record: Publish scope, evidence boundary, responsible role, decision, correction, fallback and data disposition in accessible public language.

dazhongsi_verified_baseline.evidence_boundary: Program relationships may expand; reality-checked coordinates and the Dazhongsi spatial sequence remain unchanged unless a new factual blocker is discovered.
